Neat ideas. There is only one little problem: Hell Hound can take NO
actions (in particular: no equipping actions) and there is no way to
equip an ally without letting him take an equip action (You can only
redistribute equipment or retainers with Heidelburg Castle on VAMPIRES).

simulate the automatic regeneration.

has such errata), or the effect is 'set to X' instead of '+X'.

Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
SirTemple wrote:



It is the name we gave the concept of massive armed weeny combat. I

don't want to blame the US-Army.

You rely on a horde of (replacable) foot soldiers which are armed with
the best high-tech equipment available and shoot all opposition to bits
with hideous firepower. The immense costs are paid with Consangineous
Boons and Autarkis Persecution (you will need to use Vote Domination
tactics, since you really don't want a Peace Treaty to pass. If you fail

to push your votes through, you soon feel the cold grip of a financial
defecit, just like in the US...)

Basically it is a Brujah Anarch design, using this clan's unique
abilities concerning equipment and weeny vote power for pool
refreshment.

Black Cat, Arms Dealer, Al's Army Apparatus, Vast Wealth (for Black Cat)

are the core cards for the deck.

You make massive use of:
3rd tradition and embrace (for reinforcements)
Assault Rifles and SMGs, combined with ammo cards, used with celerity
Flack Jackets for protection
the brujah allies (all at the bargain price of only 1 pool: they can
equip, Arson, Rush when equipped and count as a minion for Autarkis
Persecution)

It is fairly effective, but only when you can catch your game group in
its toes, that is when the other decks are ill-equipped to fight massive

long range firepower.

And the simulation of regeneration: Hell Hound gains 1 life if he has
less then 2 lifes during untap. I found that he is a very useful Ally in

a low combat environment and to stop unwilling trespassers bleeding you
due to a bleed bounce.

Was it that what you wanted to know?

Michael Beer
